_about: Overnight Oct 23, Part 3: the short skippable entrance before a boss, lieutenant or gatekeeper battle (BossIntro, ui/battle/boss_intro.gd). Key = the battle's enemy name as the battle shows it (for 'Name, Title' and 'Name - Phase' names the part before the separator also matches). title = the line under the name card (default: the part after ', '), line = the opening line, sting = an STG- music sting id, path = the accent colour (beefcake/necrocrat/gourmand/refusemancer/regime/neutral).

Hollow Warden.title: Keeper of the House
Hollow Warden.line: ...You smell familiar. Show me your hands.

Brick Bronson.title: The Spotter of the Gorge
Brick Bronson.line: NOBODY CROSSES THE GORGE WITHOUT A SPOTTER. I AM THE SPOTTER. SPOT THIS.

Chef Fennel Gravois.title: Keeper of the Pantry Key
Chef Fennel Gravois.line: TASTE IT. TASTE IT! It's for the war effort!

Moss Mulligan.title: The Corrupted Druid
Moss Mulligan.line: ...the green is hungry... stay... stay and be fed...

Prudence Pallor.title: Checkpoint Supervisor
Prudence Pallor.line: Your number is zero. It is always zero. Please hold.

The Restless Dead.title: Who Wait Under the Cairn
The Restless Dead.line: The stones count. One. Two. The dead are counting with them.

Shiro Swindle.title: Master of the Oldest Trick
Shiro Swindle.line: You found me! Nobody finds me. Which means this is a trick. Mine.

The Warden of the Four Seals.title: Keeper of the Four-Seal Vault
The Warden of the Four Seals.line: Four seals, four Paths, one hand. Show me the hand.

The Wellspring's Echo.title: Voice of the Old Well
The Wellspring's Echo.line: ...you came back... the water remembers the shape of you...

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.title: Iron Regent of the Gainlands
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: You. Off the wheel. Nobody leaves the Gainlands without a permit and a rep count.

Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.title: Minister of Efficiency
Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.line: You arrived four seconds late. I have already deducted it from you.

Baron Quadzilla.title: The Leg Press Lord
Baron Quadzilla.line: Nobody. Skips. Leg day. (rep) In my cave.

The Ancient Spotter.title: Guardian of Mount Swolympus
The Ancient Spotter.line: One more rep. There is always one more rep.

The Doppelganger.title: Grand Chef of the Test Kitchen (allegedly)
The Doppelganger.line: Welcome to the Test Kitchen. Everything here is delicious. I have been told.

Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.title: Director of Culinary Defense
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.line: Ration line, ATTENTION! Whisk formation! Nobody tastes anything!

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.title: CE-No of the D.N.A.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.line: The answer is no. The question is irrelevant. Please state your case anyway.

Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.title: Surly Secretary
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.line: Take a number. The number is irrelevant. Take it anyway.

Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.title: Deputy Minister of Good News
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.line: Smile, please! This fight is being broadcast, and you are losing it beautifully.

Compostella, the Rotheart.title: The Rotheart
Compostella, the Rotheart.line: I am what you throw away. I am what grows back. I am HUNGRY.

Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.title: Royal Groundskeeper
Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.line: Such a pretty weed. Such a shame. Do hold still, dear.

His Majesty the Raccoon.title: Sovereign of the Throne of Lids
His Majesty the Raccoon.line: Kneel before the Throne of Lids. Or crouch. Crouching is also acceptable.

Enforcer Captain Spotless.title: Enforcer Captain of the Grate
Enforcer Captain Spotless.line: HALT. State your height. No: do not state it. Stand at it.

Captain Spotless.title: Keeper of the Capital Gate
Captain Spotless.line: HALT. That is a smudge. That is a smudge on a CITIZEN.

Primm.title: His Perfection
Primm.line: Do mind the floor. It has just been polished, by seventeen people, whom I thank daily, in writing.

Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.title: Chief Path-ologist
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.line: Subject 1. Back where you belong. Do sit; the straps are new.

Announcer Grand Bellows.title: Voice of the Undercroft
Announcer Grand Bellows.line: IN THIS CORNER: A CHALLENGER! IN THAT CORNER: ME! (normal voice) Hello.

Colonel Casserole.title: Guardian of the Buffet Gate
Colonel Casserole.line: Halt, traveller. This gate opens for a duel of honour. Lids up. Yes, Chef.
